notes: Deploy customer independently, one instance at a time; no dependency on notifier CHG-104 and no queue drain is required. The customer keeps the existing offer.queued event name and {customerId, offerId} payload, so old and new customer/notifier versions interoperate and rollback is safe. During a mixed rollout, legacy consent customers stop producing new marketing events only on requests routed to new customer instances; existing queued events remain valid and are handled by either notifier version. If rollback is needed, route traffic back to the old customer version and leave the database and queued events untouched.
